milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task where the player must locate and observe the oak slab pavilion. Target is the center of the oak slab floor at (5, 0, 4) spawn-relative. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable exploration distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the structure.

Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce_trapdoor with an iron axe drops it as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The player starts with no spruce_trapdoor, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task where the player must locate and observe the mossy cobblestone ruins. Target is the center of the ruins at (11, 1, 5) spawn-relative. max_distance=16 allows detection from exploration distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the ruins.

Uses inventory_has because mining a spruce_log with an iron axe drops it as an item that goes into the player's inventory. The player starts with no spruce_log, so having ≥1 confirms successful mining.
